name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: A 5th-century rock fortress built by King Kashyapa, rising 200 m above the surrounding plains.

name: Ella
description: A hill-country village known for hiking trails, tea estates and the Nine Arches Bridge.

name: Galle Fort
description: A historic coastal fort built by the Portuguese and later developed by the Dutch. It is famous for its colonial architecture, old streets, lighthouse and ocean views.

name: Mirissa Beach
description: A stunning tropical beach with golden sand, turquoise water and beautiful palm trees. Visitors can enjoy swimming, surfing, whale watching and relaxing by the sea.

name: Horton Plains National Park
description: A beautiful highland national park famous for its grasslands, cloud forests, waterfalls and World's End viewpoint, which offers breathtaking mountain views.
